name: List.getElem?_take

name: List.getElem?_take_of_lt

name: List.getElem?_take_of_succ
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i : Nat}, (List.take (i + 1) l)[i]? = l[i]?

name: List.getElem?_toArray
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {xs : List α} {i : Nat}, xs.toArray[i]? = xs[i]?

name: List.getElem?_unattach

name: List.getElem?_zipIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i j : Nat}, (l.zipIdx i)[j]? = Option.map (fun a => (a, i + j)) l[j]?

name: List.getElem?_zipWith
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {as : List α} {bs : List β} {f : α → β → γ} {i : Nat}, (List.zipWith f as bs)[i]? = match as[i]?, bs[i]? with | some a, some b => some (f a b) | x, x_1 => none

name: List.getElem?_zipWith'
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {l₁ : List α} {l₂ : List β} {f : α → β → γ} {i : Nat}, (List.zipWith f l₁ l₂)[i]? = (Option.map f l₁[i]?).bind fun g => Option.map g l₂[i]?

name: List.getElem?_zipWithAll
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {as : List α} {bs : List β} {f : Option α → Option β → γ} {i : Nat}, (List.zipWithAll f as bs)[i]? = match as[i]?, bs[i]? with | none, none => none | a?, b? => some (f a? b?)

name: List.getElem_append
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l₁ l₂ : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < (l₁ ++ l₂).length), (l₁ ++ l₂)[i] = if h' : i < l₁.length then l₁[i] else l₂[i - l₁.length]

name: List.getElem_append_left
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {i : Nat} {as bs : List α} (h : i < as.length) {h' : i < (as ++ bs).length}, (as ++ bs)[i] = as[i]

name: List.getElem_append_left'
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l₁ : List α} {i : Nat} (hi : i < l₁.length) (l₂ : List α), l₁[i] = (l₁ ++ l₂)[i]

name: List.getElem_append_right
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {as bs : List α} {i : Nat} (h₁ : as.length ≤ i) {h₂ : i < (as ++ bs).length}, (as ++ bs)[i] = bs[i - as.length]

name: List.getElem_append_right'
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (l₁ : List α) {l₂ : List α} {i : Nat} (hi : i < l₂.length), l₂[i] = (l₁ ++ l₂)[i + l₁.length]

name: List.getElem_attach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < xs.attach.length), xs.attach[i] = ⟨xs[i], ⋯⟩

name: List.getElem_attachWith
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {P : α → Prop} {H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ xs → P a} {i : Nat} (h : i < (xs.attachWith P H).length), (xs.attachWith P H)[i] = ⟨xs[i], ⋯⟩

name: List.getElem_concat_length
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {a : α} {i : Nat}, i = l.length → ∀ (w : i < (l ++ [a]).length), (l ++ [a])[i] = a

name: List.getElem_cons
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {i : Nat} {a : α} {l : List α} (w : i < (a :: l).length), (a :: l)[i] = if h : i = 0 then a else l[i - 1]

name: List.getElem_cons_drop
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {as : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < as.length), as[i] :: List.drop (i + 1) as = List.drop i as

name: List.getElem_cons_length
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : α} {xs : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i = xs.length), (x :: xs)[i] = (x :: xs).getLast ⋯

name: List.getElem_cons_succ
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (a : α) (as : List α) (i : Nat) (h : i + 1 < (a :: as).length), (a :: as)[i + 1] = as[i]

name: List.getElem_cons_zero
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (a : α) (as : List α) (h : 0 < (a :: as).length), (a :: as)[0] = a

name: List.getElem_drop
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {i j : Nat} {h : j < (List.drop i xs).length}, (List.drop i xs)[j] = xs[i + j]

name: List.getElem_drop'
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {i j : Nat} (h : i + j < xs.length), xs[i + j] = (List.drop i xs)[j]

name: List.getElem_dropLast
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < xs.dropLast.length), xs.dropLast[i] = xs[i]

name: List.getElem_eraseIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i j : Nat} (h : j < (l.eraseIdx i).length), (l.eraseIdx i)[j] = if h' : j < i then l[j] else l[j + 1]

name: List.getElem_eraseIdx_of_ge
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i j : Nat} (h : j < (l.eraseIdx i).length) (h' : i ≤ j), (l.eraseIdx i)[j] = l[j + 1]

name: List.getElem_eraseIdx_of_lt
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i j : Nat} (h : j < (l.eraseIdx i).length), j < i → (l.eraseIdx i)[j] = l[j]

name: List.getElem_filter
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {p : α → Bool} {i : Nat} (h : i < (List.filter p xs).length), p (List.filter p xs)[i] = true

name: List.getElem_finRange
type: ∀ {n i : Nat} (h : i < (List.finRange n).length), (List.finRange n)[i] = Fin.cast ⋯ ⟨i, h⟩

name: List.getElem_get_maxIdxOn?
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : LE β] [inst_1 : DecidableLE β] [Std.IsLinearPreorder β] {f : α → β} {xs : List α} (h : (List.maxIdxOn? f xs).isSome = true), xs[(List.maxIdxOn? f xs).get h] = List.maxOn f xs ⋯

name: List.getElem_get_minIdxOn?
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : LE β] [inst_1 : DecidableLE β] [Std.IsLinearPreorder β] {f : α → β} {xs : List α} (h : (List.minIdxOn? f xs).isSome = true), xs[(List.minIdxOn? f xs).get h] = List.minOn f xs ⋯

name: List.getElem_idxOf
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {xs : List α} (h : List.idxOf x xs < xs.length), xs[List.idxOf x xs] = x

name: List.getElem_insert
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [inst_1 : LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} {a : α} {i : Nat} (h : i < l.length), (List.insert a l)[i] = if a ∈ l then l[i] else if i = 0 then a else l[i - 1]

name: List.getElem_insertIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {x : α} {i j : Nat} (h : j < (l.insertIdx i x).length), (l.insertIdx i x)[j] = if h₁ : j < i then l[j] else if h₂ : j = i then x else l[j - 1]

name: List.getElem_insertIdx_of_gt
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {x : α} {i j : Nat} (hn : i < j) (hk : j < (l.insertIdx i x).length), (l.insertIdx i x)[j] = l[j - 1]

name: List.getElem_insertIdx_of_lt
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {x : α} {i j : Nat} (hn : j < i) (hk : j < (l.insertIdx i x).length), (l.insertIdx i x)[j] = l[j]

name: List.getElem_insertIdx_self
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {x : α} {i : Nat} (hi : i < (l.insertIdx i x).length), (l.insertIdx i x)[i] = x

name: List.getElem_intersperse
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {sep : α} {i : Nat} (h : i < (List.intersperse sep l).length), (List.intersperse sep l)[i] = if i % 2 = 0 then l[i / 2] else sep

name: List.getElem_intersperse_two_mul
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {sep : α} {i : Nat} (h : 2 * i < (List.intersperse sep l).length), (List.intersperse sep l)[2 * i] = l[i]

name: List.getElem_intersperse_two_mul_add_one
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {sep : α} {i : Nat} (h : 2 * i + 1 < (List.intersperse sep l).length), (List.intersperse sep l)[2 * i + 1] = sep

name: List.getElem_map
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → β) {l : List α} {i : Nat} {h : i < (List.map f l).length}, (List.map f l)[i] = f l[i]

name: List.getElem_mapFinIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {as : List α} {f : (i : Nat) → α → i < as.length → β} {i : Nat} {h : i < (as.mapFinIdx f).length}, (as.mapFinIdx f)[i] = f i as[i] ⋯

name: List.getElem_mapFinIdx_go
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {bs : List α} {acc : Array β} {as : List α} {f : (i : Nat) → α → i < as.length → β} {i : Nat} {h : bs.length + acc.size = as.length} {w : i < (List.mapFinIdx.go as f bs acc h).length}, (List.mapFinIdx.go as f bs acc h)[i] = if w' : i < acc.size then acc[i] else f i bs[i - acc.size] ⋯

name: List.getElem_mapIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {f : Nat → α → β} {i : Nat} {h : i < (List.mapIdx f l).length}, (List.mapIdx f l)[i] = f i l[i]

name: List.getElem_maxIdxOn
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : LE β] [inst_1 : DecidableLE β] [Std.IsLinearPreorder β] {f : α → β} {xs : List α} (h : xs ≠ []), xs[List.maxIdxOn f xs h] = List.maxOn f xs h

name: List.getElem_mem
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {n : Nat} (h : n < l.length), l[n] ∈ l

name: List.getElem_minIdxOn
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : LE β] [inst_1 : DecidableLE β] [Std.IsLinearPreorder β] {f : α → β} {xs : List α} (h : xs ≠ []), xs[List.minIdxOn f xs h] = List.minOn f xs h

name: List.getElem_modify
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α → α) (i : Nat) (l : List α) (j : Nat) (h : j < (l.modify i f).length), (l.modify i f)[j] = if i = j then f l[j] else l[j]

name: List.getElem_modifyHead
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {f : α → α} {i : Nat} (h : i < (List.modifyHead f l).length), (List.modifyHead f l)[i] = if h' : i = 0 then f l[0] else l[i]

name: List.getElem_modifyHead_succ
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {f : α → α} {n : Nat} (h : n + 1 < (List.modifyHead f l).length), (List.modifyHead f l)[n + 1] = l[n + 1]

name: List.getElem_modifyHead_zero
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {f : α → α} {h : 0 < (List.modifyHead f l).length}, (List.modifyHead f l)[0] = f l[0]

name: List.getElem_modify_eq
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α → α) (i : Nat) (l : List α) (h : i < (l.modify i f).length), (l.modify i f)[i] = f l[i]

name: List.getElem_modify_ne
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α → α) {i j : Nat} (l : List α), i ≠ j → ∀ (h' : j < (l.modify i f).length), (l.modify i f)[j] = l[j]

name: List.getElem_ofFn
type: ∀ {n : Nat} {α : Type u_1} {i : Nat} {f : Fin n → α} (h : i < (List.ofFn f).length), (List.ofFn f)[i] = f ⟨i, ⋯⟩

name: List.getElem_of_append
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l₁ : List α} {a : α} {l₂ : List α} {i : Nat} {l : List α} (eq : l = l₁ ++ a :: l₂) (h : l₁.length = i), l[i] = a

name: List.getElem_of_eq
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l l' : List α} (h : l = l') {i : Nat} (w : i < l.length), l[i] = l'[i]

name: List.getElem_of_getElem?
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {i : Nat} {a : α} {l : List α}, l[i]? = some a → ∃ h, l[i] = a

name: List.getElem_of_mem
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, a ∈ l → ∃ i h, l[i] = a

name: List.getElem_pmap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Prop} (f : (a : α) → p a → β) {l : List α} (h : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → p a) {i : Nat} (hn : i < (List.pmap f l h).length), (List.pmap f l h)[i] = f l[i] ⋯

name: List.getElem_range
type: ∀ {j n : Nat} (h : j < (List.range n).length), (List.range n)[j] = j

name: List.getElem_range'
type: ∀ {n m step i : Nat} (H : i < (List.range' n m step).length), (List.range' n m step)[i] = n + step * i

name: List.getElem_replace
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] {a b : α} [inst_1 : LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < l.length), (l.replace a b)[i] = if (l[i] == a) = true then if a ∈ List.take i l then a else b else l[i]

name: List.getElem_replace_of_ne
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] {a b : α} [LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} {i : Nat} {h : i < l.length}, l[i] ≠ a → (l.replace a b)[i] = l[i]

name: List.getElem_replicate
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {n i : Nat} (h : i < (List.replicate n a).length), (List.replicate n a)[i] = a

name: List.getElem_reverse
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < l.reverse.length), l.reverse[i] = l[l.length - 1 - i]

name: List.getElem_scanl
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {i : Nat} {a : α} {l : List β} {f : α → β → α} (h : i < (List.scanl f a l).length), (List.scanl f a l)[i] = List.foldl f a (List.take i l)

name: List.getElem_scanl_zero
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {b : β} {l : List α} {f : β → α → β}, (List.scanl f b l)[0] = b

name: List.getElem_scanr
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {i : Nat} {b : β} {l : List α} {f : α → β → β} (h : i < (List.scanr f b l).length), (List.scanr f b l)[i] = List.foldr f b (List.drop i l)

name: List.getElem_scanr_zero
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {b : β} {l : List α} {f : α → β → β}, (List.scanr f b l)[0] = List.foldr f b l

name: List.getElem_set
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i j : Nat} {a : α} (h : j < (l.set i a).length), (l.set i a)[j] = if i = j then a else l[j]

name: List.getElem_set_ne
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i j : Nat}, i ≠ j → ∀ {a : α} (hj : j < (l.set i a).length), (l.set i a)[j] = l[j]

name: List.getElem_set_self
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i : Nat} {a : α} (h : i < (l.set i a).length), (l.set i a)[i] = a

name: List.getElem_singleton
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {i : Nat} (h : i < 1), [a][i] = a

name: List.getElem_succ_scanl
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {i : Nat} {b : β} {l : List α} {f : β → α → β} (h : i + 1 < (List.scanl f b l).length), (List.scanl f b l)[i + 1] = f (List.scanl f b l)[i] l[i]

name: List.getElem_tail
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < l.tail.length), l.tail[i] = l[i + 1]

name: List.getElem_take
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {j i : Nat} {h : i < (List.take j xs).length}, (List.take j xs)[i] = xs[i]

name: List.getElem_take'
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {i j : Nat} (hi : i < xs.length) (hj : i < j), xs[i] = (List.take j xs)[i]

name: List.getElem_toArray
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {xs : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < xs.toArray.size), xs.toArray[i] = xs[i]

name: List.getElem_toByteArray
type: ∀ {l : List UInt8} {i : Nat} {h : i < l.toByteArray.size}, l.toByteArray[i] = l[i]

name: List.getElem_unattach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {l : List { x // p x }} (i : Nat) (h : i < l.unattach.length), l.unattach[i] = l[i].val

name: List.getElem_zero
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} (h : 0 < l.length), l[0] = l.head ⋯

name: List.getElem_zip
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {l' : List β} {i : Nat} {h : i < (l.zip l').length}, (l.zip l')[i] = (l[i], l'[i])

name: List.getElem_zipIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {i j : Nat} {l : List α} (h : i < (l.zipIdx j).length), (l.zipIdx j)[i] = (l[i], j + i)

name: List.getElem_zipWith
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {f : α → β → γ} {l : List α} {l' : List β} {i : Nat} {h : i < (List.zipWith f l l').length}, (List.zipWith f l l')[i] = f l[i] l'[i]

name: List.getLast!_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Inhabited α], [].getLast! = default

name: List.getLast!_of_getLast?
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} [inst : Inhabited α] {l : List α}, l.getLast? = some a → l.getLast! = a

name: List.getLast.congr_simp
type: ∀ {α : Type u} (as as_1 : List α) (e_as : as = as_1) (a : as ≠ []), as.getLast a = as_1.getLast ⋯

name: List.getLast?_append
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l l' : List α}, (l ++ l').getLast? = l'.getLast?.or l.getLast?

name: List.getLast?_attach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α}, xs.attach.getLast? = xs.getLast?.pbind fun a h => some ⟨a, ⋯⟩

name: List.getLast?_attachWith
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {P : α → Prop} {xs : List α} {H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ xs → P a}, (xs.attachWith P H).getLast? = xs.getLast?.pbind fun a h => some ⟨a, ⋯⟩

name: List.getLast?_concat
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {a : α}, (l ++ [a]).getLast? = some a

name: List.getLast?_cons
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a :: l).getLast? = some (l.getLast?.getD a)

name: List.getLast?_cons_cons
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a b : α} {l : List α}, (a :: b :: l).getLast? = (b :: l).getLast?

name: List.getLast?_cons_of_ne_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : α} {xs : List α}, xs ≠ [] → (x :: xs).getLast? = xs.getLast?

name: List.getLast?_drop
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {i : Nat} {l : List α}, (List.drop i l).getLast? = if l.length ≤ i then none else l.getLast?

name: List.getLast?_dropLast
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α}, xs.dropLast.getLast? = if xs.length ≤ 1 then none else xs[xs.length - 2]?

name: List.getLast?_filter
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {l : List α}, (List.filter p l).getLast? = List.find? p l.reverse

name: List.getLast?_filterMap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → Option β} {l : List α}, (List.filterMap f l).getLast? = List.findSome? f l.reverse

name: List.getLast?_flatMap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {f : α → List β}, (List.flatMap f l).getLast? = List.findSome? (fun a => (f a).getLast?) l.reverse

name: List.getLast?_flatten
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {L : List (List α)}, L.flatten.getLast? = List.findSome? (fun l => l.getLast?) L.reverse

name: List.getLast?_isSome
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α}, l.getLast?.isSome = true ↔ l ≠ []

name: List.getLast?_map
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} {l : List α}, (List.map f l).getLast? = Option.map f l.getLast?

name: List.getLast?_mapIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {f : Nat → α → β}, (List.mapIdx f l).getLast? = Option.map (f (l.length - 1)) l.getLast?

name: List.getLast?_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u}, [].getLast? = none

name: List.getLast?_pmap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {P : α → Prop} {f : (a : α) → P a → β} {xs : List α} (H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ xs → P a), (List.pmap f xs H).getLast? = Option.map (fun x => match x with | ⟨a, m⟩ => f a ⋯) xs.attach.getLast?

name: List.getLast?_range
type: ∀ {n : Nat}, (List.range n).getLast? = if n = 0 then none else some (n - 1)

name: List.getLast?_range'

name: Option.any_bind

name: Option.any_false

name: Option.any_filter

name: Option.any_guard

name: Option.any_join

name: Option.any_map

name: Option.any_max

name: Option.any_none

name: Option.any_some

name: Option.any_true

name: Option.any_unattach

name: Option.apply_get

name: Option.attachWith_guard
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {q : α → Bool} {x : α} {P : α → Prop} {h : ∀ (a : α), Option.guard q x = some a → P a}, (Option.guard q x).attachWith P h = if h' : q x = true then some ⟨x, ⋯⟩ else none

type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {o : Option α} (f : α → β) {P : β → Prop} {H : ∀ (b : β), Option.map f o = some b → P b}, (Option.map f o).attachWith P H = Option.map (fun x => match x with | ⟨x, h⟩ => ⟨f x, h⟩) (o.attachWith (P ∘ f) ⋯)

name: Option.attachWith_map_subtype_val

name: Option.attachWith_map_val
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Prop} (f : α → β) (o : Option α) (H : ∀ (a : α), o = some a → p a), Option.map (fun i => f i.val) (o.attachWith p H) = Option.map f o

name: Option.attachWith_none

name: Option.attachWith_some

name: Option.attach_congr

name: Option.attach_filter

name: Option.attach_guard
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {x : α}, (Option.guard p x).attach = if h : p x = true then some ⟨x, ⋯⟩ else none

name: Option.attach_map
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {o : Option α} (f : α → β), (Option.map f o).attach = Option.map (fun x => match x with | ⟨x, h⟩ => ⟨f x, ⋯⟩) o.attach

name: Option.attach_map_subtype_val
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (o : Option α), Option.map Subtype.val o.attach = o

name: Option.attach_map_val
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (o : Option α) (f : α → β), Option.map (fun i => f i.val) o.attach = Option.map f o

name: Option.attach_none
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, none.attach = none

name: Option.attach_pfilter

name: Option.attach_some
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : α}, (some x).attach = some ⟨x, ⋯⟩

name: Option.attach_toList

name: Option.bindM_none

name: Option.bindM_some
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Pure m] (a : α) (f : α → m (Option β)), Option.bindM f (some a) = f a

name: Option.bind_attach

name: Option.bind_comm

name: Option.bind_congr
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {o : Option α} {f g : α → Option β}, (∀ (a : α), o = some a → f a = g a) → o.bind f = o.bind g

name: Option.bind_fun_none
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (x : Option α), (x.bind fun x => none) = none

name: Option.bind_fun_some
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (x : Option α), x.bind some = x

name: Option.bind_guard
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (x : Option α) (p : α → Bool), x.bind (Option.guard p) = Option.filter p x

name: Option.bind_join
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → Option β} {o : Option (Option α)}, o.join.bind f = o.bind fun x => x.bind f

name: Option.bind_map

name: Option.bind_map_comm
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {x : Option (Option α)} {f : α → β}, x.bind (Option.map f) = (Option.map (Option.map f) x).bind id

name: Option.bind_none
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → Option β), none.bind f = none

name: Option.bind_some
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (a : α) (f : α → Option β), (some a).bind f = f a

name: Option.bind_subtype
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Prop} {o : Option { x // p x }} {f : { x // p x } → Option β} {g : α → Option β}, (∀ (x : α) (h : p x), f ⟨x, h⟩ = g x) → o.bind f = o.unattach.bind g

name: Option.commutative_merge
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α → α → α) [Std.Commutative f], Std.Commutative (Option.merge f)

name: Option.comp_map
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {γ : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} (h : β → γ) (g : α → β) (x : Option α), Option.map (h ∘ g) x = Option.map h (Option.map g x)

name: Option.elimM_bind
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α β γ : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (x : m α) (f : α → m (Option β)) (y : m γ) (z : β → m γ), Option.elimM (x >>= f) y z = do let __do_lift ← x Option.elimM (f __do_lift) y z

name: Option.elimM_map

name: Option.elimM_pure

name: Option.elim_filter

name: Option.elim_guard

name: Option.elim_map

name: Option.elim_none

name: Option.filterM_none

name: Option.filterM_some

name: Option.filter_attach

name: Option.filter_bind

name: Option.filter_filter

name: Option.filter_guard

name: Option.filter_join

name: Option.filter_le

name: Option.filter_map

name: Option.filter_none
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (p : α → Bool), Option.filter p none = none

name: Option.filter_pfilter

name: Option.filter_some

name: Option.filter_some_neg

name: Option.filter_some_pos

name: Option.foldlM_toList
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (o : Option β) (a : α) (f : α → β → m α), List.foldlM f a o.toList = o.elim (pure a) fun b => f a b

name: Option.foldl_toArray
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} (o : Option β) (a : α) (f : α → β → α), Array.foldl f a o.toArray = o.elim a fun b => f a b

name: Option.foldl_toList
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} (o : Option β) (a : α) (f : α → β → α), List.foldl f a o.toList = o.elim a fun b => f a b

name: Option.foldrM_toArray
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (o : Option β) (a : α) (f : β → α → m α), Array.foldrM f a o.toArray = o.elim (pure a) fun b => f b a

name: Option.foldrM_toList
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (o : Option β) (a : α) (f : β → α → m α), List.foldrM f a o.toList = o.elim (pure a) fun b => f b a

name: Option.foldr_toArray
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} (o : Option β) (a : α) (f : β → α → α), Array.foldr f a o.toArray = o.elim a fun b => f b a

name: Option.foldr_toList

name: Option.forIn'_congr
